response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished software engineer with 15+ years of experience and strong general software craftsmanship, he is fundamentally misaligned with this role. Most critically, he lacks the required native-level Japanese language proficiency. Additionally, his entire career has focused on web, mobile, and GIS applications rather than embedded firmware development. He has no demonstrated experience with security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption), networking protocols, Linux kernel modification, or embedded networking systems—all core requirements for this position. His C experience dates to 2014-2015 and has been superseded by web technologies.
strengths: Extensive software development experience (15+ years) with proven ability to master multiple programming languages and domains
Strong DevOps and infrastructure knowledge including Docker, CI/CD, and development environment setup that could support embedded development workflows
Demonstrated problem-solving skills and low-level systems exposure through C/C++ work at National Instruments and performance optimization in D
concerns: No native-level Japanese language proficiency (explicitly required qualification) with only English, Romanian, and basic German listed
Career entirely focused on web, mobile, and GIS applications with no embedded systems, firmware, or networking stack experience
No security domain expertise: no mention of cryptography, authentication protocols, MACsec, 802.1X, or any security technology implementation

key_factors.factor: No embedded systems or security firmware background
General software engineering excellence and adaptability
